cis-2-butene and trans-2-butene
Geometric diastereomers with molecular formula C4H8. The Z (cis) and E (trans) configurations have different arrangements across the carbon-carbon double bond.
cis-2-butene: C/C=C\C
trans-2-butene: C/C=C/C

maleic acid and fumaric acid
Geometric diastereomers with molecular formula C4H4O4. Maleic acid is Z-butenedioic acid; fumaric acid is E-butenedioic acid.
maleic acid: C(=C\C(=O)O)\C(=O)O
fumaric acid: C(=C/C(=O)O)\C(=O)O
provenance: PubChem structure identities 444266 and 444972; explicit stereochemical relation reviewed independently. Original prose and formatting; factual identity/calculated structures only. URLs and checksums in chemistry/source_manifest.json.

L-alanine and D-alanine
Enantiomers with molecular formula C3H7NO2. L-alanine has S configuration and D-alanine has R configuration at the alpha carbon. D/L labels specify configuration; optical-rotation sign is a separate property.
L-alanine: C[C@@H](C(=O)O)N
D-alanine: C[C@H](C(=O)O)N
provenance: PubChem structure identities 5950 and 71080; explicit stereochemical relation reviewed independently. Original prose and formatting; factual identity/calculated structures only. URLs and checksums in chemistry/source_manifest.json.

D-glucose and D-galactose
Diastereomers with molecular formula C6H12O6. In their open-chain forms these aldohexoses differ at carbon 4 and are C4 epimers; glucose and fructose instead differ in connectivity.
D-glucose: C([C@@H]1[C@H]([C@@H]([C@H](C(O1)O)O)O)O)O
D-galactose: C([C@@H]1[C@@H]([C@@H]([C@H](C(O1)O)O)O)O)O
provenance: PubChem structure identities 5793 and 6036; explicit stereochemical relation reviewed independently. Original prose and formatting; factual identity/calculated structures only. URLs and checksums in chemistry/source_manifest.json.
